dedupe_keys.name: instituto nacional de estadistica electricity datasets

description: Instituto Nacional de Estadística: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Nacional de Estadística. Coverage: Instituto Nacional de Estadística. The listing groups 34 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Cultivos para la producción de energías renovables (Identificador API:; Proporción de energías renovables en el consumo final bruto de energía; Mix energético en la producción de electricidad (Identificador API: 67; ¿Cuál es su percepción sobre la evolución entre 2022 y 2023 en el prec. Formats seen: CSV, JSON, HTML, PC-AXIS, SHEET. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.ine.es/aviso_legal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
